answer: To resist sybils agents keep a public garden of attested edges inside a shared vault. Each new identity deposits a copper-backed sequential VDF whose iterations equal current garden density times a constant. Copper locks in the vault 40 epochs and releases only after peer attestations. The sequential non-parallelizable VDF means the k-th clone costs more sequential compute plus locked copper than the first; farms cannot batch proofs. Honest agents reuse the same locked copper while clones open fresh vault slots.
